messages:
jamie.ops: PAGED by pagerbot: unusual 401 spike from service-proxy (svc-proxy-01/02) in us-east-1 — ~1.2k 401s in last 3m. Not correlated to deploy. Seeing repeated token validation failures.

pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager: auth-service:auth-proxy high 401 rate — paging jamie.ops, mike-oncall

jamie.ops: looking. I'm seeing requests with same token fingerprint hitting multiple tenants. Suspicious. Linking logs: https://internal-logs/abc123

mike-oncall: oncall here, joining. Can you dump recent authorization headers (scrubbed) + sample IPs? Also tag impacted customers.

jamie.ops: pasted sample (scrubbed) — `bearer <redacted>...` coming from 35.198.52.11 -> many spikes. No deploy, no config change. Rollout status: green.

lily-sre: checking edge proxy ACLs and egress; adding WAF rule to block 35.198.52.11 temporarily :eyes:

sara.security: triage: treat as suspected credential replay. Actions: 1) rotate service tokens for svc-proxy (short window), 2) revoke suspect session tokens, 3) notify legal if customer data risk. I'll own rotation plan. :+1:

jamie.ops: plan: 1) create ephemeral blocklist at edge (lily) 2) issue job to revoke session tokens matching fingerprint 3) coordinate key rotation for svc-proxy service account (mike)

mike-oncall: running revoke script now: 
```
# revoke sessions matching fingerprint
./ops/revoke_sessions --fingerprint XyZ123 --dry-run=false
# rotate service key
redwoodctl secrets rotate --service svc-proxy --key-id ak-09
```

ETA for rotation ~ 6 minutes

pagerbot: incident created INC-2026-1458 — severity: P1 — channel: #incidents — runbook link: https://wiki/incident/rotate-auth-keys

jamie.ops: monitoring auth 401s after block/rotate. Early signals: 401s dropped ~70% after block, some residual traffic from different IPs.

sara.security: start full key sweep across all proxies (dedicated + staging). Also prepare customer impact assessment. Jamie, can you check logs for any access to PII/keys? Lily, freeze log exports from suspected buckets.

lily-sre: disabled logshipper -> s3-forwarder for suspect pipelines. Confirmed no S3 object reads from attacker IPs. :white_check_mark:

mike-oncall: rotation completed, new key active, rolling fallback enabled. Running smoke tests.

jamie.ops: smoke ok. 401 rate now trending toward baseline, but will monitor 30m. Creating postmortem stub and adding timeline.

sara.security: Legal looped in (legal@redwood) as precaution. We'll schedule customer notif only if evidence of data access. For now, customer-facing comms on hold.

mike-oncall: handoff to second-level oncall @mira in 25m. I'll leave notes in incident channel and handoff summary.

mira: acknowledged, will continue monitoring and finish cleanup in next rotation window.

jamie.ops: thanks all. Quick wins: blocklist, rotate, revoke. Next: confirm token leak vector and patch proxy to reject replayed fingerprints.

sara.security: tracking tasks in INC-2026-1458, we'll reconvene for RCA tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :calendar:

jamie.ops: closing channel for now, will post updates. :lock:
